newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault has no plan to sell Renault VI unit.
newsitem.headline: Renault has no plan to sell Renault VI unit.

text.p: Renault SA Chairman Louis Schweitzer said on Wednesday that the group had no plans to sell its commercial vehicles unit, Renault Vehicules Industriels.
"We are not considering a sale of Renault Vehicules Industriels," he told a parliamentary commission in response to a question on the group's plans for its trucks unit.
Schweitzer defended the group's decisions to close its Belgian Vilvoorde plant and eliminate 2,764 jobs in the car operations in France this year.
He told the panel it would continue cutting jobs to the year 2000. "Unfortunately, from here to the year 2000, I see continuing reductions in staff at Renault's car operations," he said.
